title: Hegseth responds to report Russia shared intel with Iran
summary: In response to reports that Russia is providing intel to Iran on U.S. positions and movements, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told 60 Minutes, "We're tracking everything. Our commanders are aware of everything… No one's putting us in danger..." CBS News' Major Garrett interviews Hegseth about the state of the war with Iran, Sunday on 60 Minutes.
